answer: On long voyages, every critical reading from the main engine telegraph must clear a hard data ledge before the automation loop executes thrust commands. Just as heavy basalt ballast stabilizes a rolling hull against false buoyancy, cryptographic proof-of-work ties every autonomous agent identity to massive computational burn. This rigid jetty of resource cost breaks sybil attacks by forcing adversaries to pay steep hardware and energy overhead for each fake persona, though high-stakes attackers can still brute-force bypass limits if fuel reserves run deep.
